coverage: November 26, 2026 · Pacific time · 3 selected updates on a quiet U.S. Thanksgiving

stories.title: Hermes highlights its official Obsidian integration
stories.summary: Nous Research highlighted its Obsidian integration for searching, reading and managing vault notes. The package provides skills; selected content can still be processed by the AI model in use.
stories.insight: Test retrieval, citations and edit history on a small set of non-sensitive notes before expanding access.

stories.title: fal extends its Seedance 2.5 free-generation offer
stories.summary: fal announced that its Seedance 2.5 free-generation promotion runs through December 1. Account eligibility, quotas and supported entry points should be checked in the current offer.
stories.insight: Use the same product brief to compare shot ideas, usable-output rates and revision effort.

stories.title: Demo: Mistral Large 4 locates targets on maps
stories.summary: Mistral shared a visual-grounding demo showing Large 4 finding matches and outlining them on a map. This is a demonstration of an existing model, without a new benchmark table attached to the post.
stories.insight: Test localization and evidence on real floor plans or dense pages before relying on a promotional demonstration.
